item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - The Feeling - Singles 2006-2011 (Deluxe Edition)
item.description:
Happy 2026!

Does anyone have this iTunes-exclusive deluxe edition by The Feeling? Or at least the bonus audio AAC M4A tracks?

15 This Promise
16 Truth Comes Out
17 This Time (Orchestral Vocal Version)

It's no longer available on the UK iTunes store, but is still on some (Kenya, Sweden and India anyway) but it's just called 'The Feeling' for some reason;

https://music.apple.com/se/album/the-feeling-deluxe-edition/1452849711

Thanks in advance!
